title: 2024 Panini Mosaic Green Mosaic Prizm #383 Jaylen Wright Miami Dolphins Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 2024 Panini Mosaic trading card featuring Jaylen Wright, a rookie player for the Miami Dolphins in the National Football League (NFL). The card is a Green Mosaic Prizm parallel variety, with card number 383. It is manufactured by Panini and is part of the 2024 set.
